title: Rodent microdialysis studies show DMT levels spike at death

plain: In laboratory studies, researchers sampled the brain chemistry of living rats and then killed them, and found that levels of DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound the brain makes itself, rose sharply as the animals died. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore describes these studies to Michels without naming them. If true, it suggests the dying brain floods itself with the same chemical people take to reach what they describe as other worlds.
